You are now strong enough for the Survival Arena. In Giran, next to the Class Master, the Arena Master Pilkins runs it.

Stake %medal%s and face a single challenger, wave after wave: the whole payout is multiplied by the medals you stake. It grows stronger every wave and enrages if a wave takes too long. You are paid for every wave you clear, whether you fall or walk out - and dying there costs no experience or buffs.

Waves roll omens (Glass Cannon, Vampiric, Frenzy...) that pay more, quick clears build a swift streak, and after every fifth wave you get a breather, a boon of your choice and a Sealed Cache. Your first run each day pays more, and an announced Arena Rush raises every payout for a while. Type .arena during a run to see it.

Once you have a record you can start at a later wave, or trade a medal for half your best payout in a quick run. The best runs make the Hall of Champions.

Spend the %coin%s at Dortmund, the Arena Merchant beside him, on crafting materials.
